messages:
Tomas: Heads-up: were rolling out a "review batching" opt-in for teams that have heavy hiring interview windows overlapping the review cycle. Goal: reduce handback spikes and interviewer burnout.

Nina: Nice. How does batching work? Does it delay peer-feedback delivery to ICs?

Maya: Short version: batching groups reviewer assignments into time-boxed bins (e.g., 24h windows). Reviewers get a single bundled queue instead of intermittent items. It does not change final due dates; it smooths load.

Jordan: If a reviewer is interviewing 3 days in a row, can leads mark them as "interview-batch" so their items are held until the end of their interview window?

Maya: Yes 1: leads can set `interview_hold_until` on the reviewer profile. System will hold new peer-feedback assignments until that timestamp. Existing pending handbacks remain unless you choose "defer and reassign".

Priya: Is there an SLA impact? Managers want to keep median response time under 48h for fairness.

ops-bot: Batching SLA note: items held by `interview_hold` are exempt from auto-reassign for the hold period. Post-hold items are prioritized to restore median response time within 36h. If prioritization cannot meet SLA, system notifies managers and suggests temporary reviewer pool.

Nina: Temporary reviewer pool? How do we staff that quickly?

Maya: We added a lightweight cross-team volunteer pool feature. Leads can opt-in their eligible reviewers (no LOA, <20 pending) for emergency coverage. Add via console: Team > Review Settings > Volunteer Pool.

Tomas: Can volunteers be auto-assigned or is it manual? We want minimal overhead.

ops-bot: Volunteer pool mode: `auto-assign` or `manual-assign`. Default is manual. `auto-assign` will pull from volunteers round-robin but respects the soft limit of 24 pending handbacks per volunteer.

Jordan: Conflict question: what if a reviewer is in the volunteer pool but also scheduled for interviews? We don't want accidental overload.

Maya: The system checks `interview_hold` and LOA flags before assignment. If conflict, it skips the reviewer. Admins can also set a weekly max-assignment cap per volunteer.

Priya: Will batching affect calibration sample composition? If many items are held and then released at once, calibration buckets could skew.

Maya: Calibration freeze policy: items in `interview_hold` are excluded from calibration sample unless a manager raises an `include_post_hold` exception within 12h of release. We annotate buckets with a flag when held items are injected.

Nina: Ops request: please surface a dashboard widget showing number of reviewers in `interview_hold`, volunteers available, and projected backlog if all holds release at the same time.

ops-bot: Widget tracked as "Review Load Forecast" 1: available in Console > Dashboards > Performance Ops. It estimates backlog using current hold expirations and volunteer capacity.

Tomas: One more 1: hiring teams sometimes want reviewing privileges for interviewers (to avoid bias). Is there guidance?

Maya: Policy: interviewers can be reviewers, but conflicts of interest must be disclosed. We encourage leads to avoid assigning interviewers to feedback for direct reports theyve interviewed within the last 90 days. Use `conflict_flag` in the console.

Jordan: Cool. How do we bulk-tag interviewers so theyre not assigned feedback for candidates they interviewed?

Maya: There's a CSV import: `handle,interviewed_candidate_ids` that flags reviewer relations. Endpoint and example on the Help doc: https://redwoodinference.internal/peopleops/interviewer-flags

Priya: Anything managers should communicate to their teams this week?

Tomas: Please tell teams: (1) if youre interviewing heavily, ask your lead to set `interview_hold`; (2) opt-in to volunteer pools if you can help; (3) exceptions for calibration will be manual and audited.

Nina: I'll send a short blurb to managers and a banner in the review console.

ops-bot: Feature rollout note: review batching and volunteer pool enabled for 30% of org today, full rollout scheduled next Tuesday 09:00 PT. Feedback link: /peopleops/feedback#batching.
